{
 "_comment": [
  "The one truth for the A3 system's OSC vocabulary, ports, IPs and network.",
  "Decided on 2026-09-30: every program reads this file (a3_osc.py for Python),",
  "or is rendered from it at install, and nothing else carries these facts.",
  "The register (a3-core tools/tests) fails on any address, port or IP literal",
  "found outside it. Change a fact here and every device follows.",
  "",
  "network: what the a3-core package configures (systemd-networkd).",
  "hosts: every machine by name.",
  "listeners: who listens where -- program, role, host, port.",
  "routes: who sends to which listener. carries: vu marks the meters going to a",
  "  port that is not a vu listener (the mixer takes them on its OSC port).",
  "addresses: our vocabulary. {ch} counts 1..4, {n} counts 1..40.",
  "  args: the type on the wire. Core announces switches and lamps as floats (0.0/1.0) and",
  "  reads every value with float(), so the mixer's values, sent as text, count too. f|s:",
  "  the filter mode arrives as a name from the desk (high_pass) and a number from Motion.",
  "  relayed_to: Core passes an arrival on to these, the sender left out.",
  "  announced_to: Core says it itself, to everybody, the sender too -- a lamp",
  "  is status, so the desk's lamp follows the desk's own key.",
  "external: vocabularies we speak but do not own (REAPER, the IEM plug-ins).",
  "meters: how every display moves a meter bar (decided 2026-10-07). The sources",
  "  send raw peaks; each display applies these on its own clock: attack (0 =",
  "  at once), release in dB per second, and how long the highest peak is held."
 ],
 "version": 1,
 "network": {
  "interface": "eno1",
  "address": "192.168.8.10/24",
  "gateway": "192.168.8.1",
  "dns": "192.168.8.1",
  "audio_port": "enp5s0",
  "audio_address": "192.168.9.10/24"
 },
 "hosts": {
  "core": "192.168.8.10",
  "mixer": "192.168.8.11",
  "radla": "192.168.43.96",
  "local": "127.0.0.1",
  "any": "0.0.0.0",
  "aes67-core": "239.69.150.243",
  "sap": "239.255.255.255",
  "ptp": "224.0.1.129"
 },
 "listeners": [
  {"name": "core.osc", "program": "core", "role": "osc", "host": "any", "port": 9000,
   "carries": "every controller's messages, and /beat from the analyzer"},
  {"name": "core.reaper-feedback", "program": "core", "role": "reaper-feedback", "host": "local", "port": 9002,
   "carries": "REAPER's own OSC feedback"},
  {"name": "core.vu-relay", "program": "core", "role": "vu-relay", "host": "local", "port": 9003,
   "carries": "the analyzer's and StemDeck's /vu bundles, forwarded unchanged to the remote Motion followed and to every desk followed (the analyzer needs OSC_VU_core=127.0.0.1:9003; Core renders it into the analyzer's conf.d, 50-a3-osc.env)"},
  {"name": "core.web", "program": "core", "role": "web", "host": "any", "port": 9080,
   "carries": "the traffic window (HTTP, not OSC); every interface, decided 2026-09-30"},
  {"name": "motion.osc", "program": "motion", "role": "osc", "host": "any", "port": 7771,
   "carries": "Core's relays (StemDeck's preview among them), /beat"},
  {"name": "motion.vu", "program": "motion", "role": "vu", "host": "any", "port": 7772,
   "carries": "the analyzer's /vu bundles"},
  {"name": "motion.energy", "program": "motion", "role": "energy", "host": "any", "port": 7777,
   "carries": "the IEM EnergyVisualizer's /EnergyVisualizer/RMS"},
  {"name": "stemdeck.osc", "program": "stemdeck", "role": "osc", "host": "any", "port": 7780,
   "carries": "Core's bus switches and its request for all of them"},
  {"name": "devices.announce", "program": "devices", "role": "announce", "host": "any", "port": 7790,
   "carries": "Core's /core/here broadcast: where every device fetches the truth"},
  {"name": "mixer.osc", "program": "mixer", "role": "osc", "host": "mixer", "port": 7772,
   "carries": "Core's relays and lamps, /beat, /vu"},
  {"name": "desk.osc", "program": "desk", "role": "osc", "host": "any", "port": 7773,
   "carries": "Core's relays, lamps and stems, /beat -- every virtual desk Core follows (four at most)"},
  {"name": "desk.vu", "program": "desk", "role": "vu", "host": "any", "port": 7774,
   "carries": "the analyzer's and StemDeck's /vu bundles, forwarded unchanged by Core (core.vu-relay)"},
  {"name": "beat-analyzer.clock", "program": "beat-analyzer", "role": "clock", "host": "any", "port": 7775,
   "carries": "/tap, /clockmode, and /beat from Motion in clock mode 0"},
  {"name": "reaper.osc", "program": "reaper", "role": "osc", "host": "local", "port": 9001,
   "carries": "Core's /track/... control"},
  {"name": "iem.multiencoder-1", "program": "iem", "role": "multiencoder-1", "host": "local", "port": 1337,
   "carries": "/MultiEncoder/... (receiver set inside the plug-in, in the REAPER project)"},
  {"name": "iem.multiencoder-2", "program": "iem", "role": "multiencoder-2", "host": "local", "port": 1338,
   "carries": "/MultiEncoder/... (receiver set inside the plug-in, in the REAPER project)"},
  {"name": "iem.multiencoder-3", "program": "iem", "role": "multiencoder-3", "host": "local", "port": 1339,
   "carries": "/MultiEncoder/... (receiver set inside the plug-in, in the REAPER project)"},
  {"name": "dualdelay.osc", "program": "dualdelay", "role": "osc", "host": "local", "port": 1340,
   "carries": "/DualDelay/delayBPML|R (receiver set inside the plug-in, in the REAPER project)"},
  {"name": "engine.osc", "program": "engine", "role": "osc", "host": "local", "port": 9004,
   "carries": "a3-engine-bench: the /channel/{ch}/... controls of the four engine strips (not yet routed by Core)"},
  {"name": "x11vnc.vnc", "program": "x11vnc", "role": "vnc", "host": "any", "port": 5901,
   "carries": "the Core's screen (VNC, not OSC)"},
  {"name": "screencast.stream", "program": "screencast", "role": "stream", "host": "any", "port": 9930,
   "protocol": "tcp", "carries": "the screen's picture as MPEG-TS, several viewers on one encode (OBS, the pro-DJ apps) (listener, not OSC)"},
  {"name": "radla.osc", "program": "radla", "role": "osc", "host": "radla", "port": 9000,
   "carries": "/beat"},
  {"name": "radla.vu", "program": "radla", "role": "vu", "host": "radla", "port": 9001,
   "carries": "/vu"},
  {"name": "prolink.announce", "program": "prolink", "role": "announce", "host": "any", "port": 50000,
   "carries": "Pro DJ Link keep-alives (broadcast, not OSC)"},
  {"name": "prolink.beat", "program": "prolink", "role": "beat", "host": "any", "port": 50001,
   "carries": "Pro DJ Link beat packets (broadcast, not OSC)"},
  {"name": "prolink.status", "program": "prolink", "role": "status", "host": "any", "port": 50002,
   "carries": "Pro DJ Link status packets (broadcast, not OSC)"},
  {"name": "aes67.stream", "program": "aes67", "role": "stream", "host": "aes67-core", "port": 5004,
   "carries": "the Core's 12 channels as AES67 (RTP, L24, 44.1 kHz, 0.5 ms packets), multicast on the audio socket; not OSC"},
  {"name": "aes67.sap", "program": "aes67", "role": "sap", "host": "sap", "port": 9875,
   "carries": "AES67 stream announcements (SAP/SDP), multicast on the audio socket, every sender and receiver; not OSC"},
  {"name": "ptp4l.event", "program": "ptp4l", "role": "event", "host": "ptp", "port": 319,
   "carries": "PTP event messages; the Core is master on the audio socket; not OSC"},
  {"name": "ptp4l.general", "program": "ptp4l", "role": "general", "host": "ptp", "port": 320,
   "carries": "PTP general messages (announce, follow-up); not OSC"}
 ],
 "routes": [
  {"from": "mixer", "to": "core.osc"},
  {"from": "mixer", "to": "beat-analyzer.clock"},
  {"from": "desk", "to": "core.osc"},
  {"from": "prodj", "to": "core.osc"},
  {"from": "desk", "to": "beat-analyzer.clock"},
  {"from": "prodj", "to": "beat-analyzer.clock"},
  {"from": "motion", "to": "core.osc"},
  {"from": "motion", "to": "beat-analyzer.clock"},
  {"from": "core", "to": "motion.osc"},
  {"from": "core", "to": "motion.vu"},
  {"from": "core", "to": "mixer.osc"},
  {"from": "core", "to": "desk.osc"},
  {"from": "core", "to": "desk.vu", "carries": "vu"},
  {"from": "core", "to": "reaper.osc"},
  {"from": "core", "to": "iem.multiencoder-1"},
  {"from": "core", "to": "iem.multiencoder-2"},
  {"from": "core", "to": "iem.multiencoder-3"},
  {"from": "core", "to": "dualdelay.osc"},
  {"from": "reaper", "to": "core.reaper-feedback"},
  {"from": "beat-analyzer", "to": "core.osc"},
  {"from": "beat-analyzer", "to": "motion.osc"},
  {"from": "beat-analyzer", "to": "mixer.osc"},
  {"from": "beat-analyzer", "to": "radla.osc"},
  {"from": "beat-analyzer", "to": "motion.vu"},
  {"from": "beat-analyzer", "to": "core.vu-relay", "carries": "vu"},
  {"from": "beat-analyzer", "to": "mixer.osc", "carries": "vu"},
  {"from": "beat-analyzer", "to": "radla.vu"},
  {"from": "iem", "to": "motion.energy"},
  {"from": "stemdeck", "to": "prolink.announce"},
  {"from": "stemdeck", "to": "prolink.status"},
  {"from": "stemdeck", "to": "prolink.beat"},
  {"from": "stemdeck", "to": "core.osc"},
  {"from": "core", "to": "stemdeck.osc"},
  {"from": "core", "to": "devices.announce"},
  {"from": "stemdeck", "to": "mixer.osc", "carries": "vu"},
  {"from": "stemdeck", "to": "core.vu-relay", "carries": "vu"},
  {"from": "prolink", "to": "prolink.beat"}
 ],
 "addresses": {
  "channel.gain":             {"pattern": "/channel/{ch}/gain", "args": "f", "ch": [1, 4], "from": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj", "motion"], "to": ["core"], "relayed_to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "input trim"},
  "channel.eq.high":          {"pattern": "/channel/{ch}/eq/high", "args": "f", "ch": [1, 4], "from": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj", "motion"], "to": ["core"], "relayed_to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "EQ high band"},
  "channel.eq.mid":           {"pattern": "/channel/{ch}/eq/mid", "args": "f", "ch": [1, 4], "from": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj", "motion"], "to": ["core"], "relayed_to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "EQ mid band"},
  "channel.eq.low":           {"pattern": "/channel/{ch}/eq/low", "args": "f", "ch": [1, 4], "from": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj", "motion"], "to": ["core"], "relayed_to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "EQ low band"},
  "channel.volume":           {"pattern": "/channel/{ch}/volume", "args": "f", "ch": [1, 4], "from": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj", "motion"], "to": ["core"], "relayed_to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "channel fader"},
  "channel.aux-send":         {"pattern": "/channel/{ch}/aux-send", "args": "f", "ch": [1, 4], "from": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj", "motion"], "to": ["core"], "relayed_to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "send to the FX bus (the beat-synced DualDelay)"},
  "channel.cue":              {"pattern": "/channel/{ch}/cue", "args": "f", "ch": [1, 4], "from": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj", "motion"], "to": ["core"], "announced_to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "cue the channel to the headphones (its pre-fader send to enc_phones); was pfl until 2026-10-01"},
  "channel.cue.led":          {"pattern": "/channel/{ch}/cue/led", "args": "f", "ch": [1, 4], "from": ["core"], "to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "the cue lamp, 1 = lit"},
  "channel.filter":           {"pattern": "/channel/{ch}/filter", "args": "f", "ch": [1, 4], "from": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj", "motion"], "to": ["core"], "announced_to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "this channel through the master filter"},
  "channel.filter.led":       {"pattern": "/channel/{ch}/filter/led", "args": "f", "ch": [1, 4], "from": ["core"], "to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "the filter key's lamp, 1 = lit"},
  "channel.filter.frequency": {"pattern": "/channel/{ch}/filter/frequency", "args": "f", "ch": [1, 4], "from": ["motion"], "to": ["core"], "relayed_to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "the channel's own filter cutoff (was pot_1)"},
  "channel.filter.q":         {"pattern": "/channel/{ch}/filter/q", "args": "f", "ch": [1, 4], "from": ["motion"], "to": ["core"], "relayed_to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "the channel's own filter Q (was pot_2)"},
  "channel.3d":               {"pattern": "/channel/{ch}/3d", "args": "f", "ch": [1, 4], "from": ["motion"], "to": ["core"], "relayed_to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "how much of the channel's isolated band moves, as an amplitude 0..1; the steady rest never changes"},
  "channel.azimuth":          {"pattern": "/channel/{ch}/azimuth", "args": "f", "ch": [1, 4], "from": ["motion"], "to": ["core"], "relayed_to": ["prodj"], "meaning": "the channel's direction, degrees; live only to the pro-DJ apps followed; a recall replays the last one to everyone, as before"},
  "channel.elevation":        {"pattern": "/channel/{ch}/elevation", "args": "f", "ch": [1, 4], "from": ["motion"], "to": ["core"], "relayed_to": ["prodj"], "meaning": "the channel's height, degrees; live only to the pro-DJ apps followed; a recall replays the last one to everyone, as before"},
  "channel.stem.turn":        {"pattern": "/channel/{ch}/stem/turn", "args": "i", "ch": [1, 4], "from": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj"], "to": ["core"], "meaning": "the channel's encoder turned by this many clicks (signed): moves its selector's cursor over the channel's three positions in a ring -- on channel N: deck 1's stem N, deck 2's stem N, then A, the analog input; left from deck 1's stem N is A; switches nothing"},
  "channel.stem":             {"pattern": "/channel/{ch}/stem", "args": "i", "ch": [1, 4], "from": ["core"], "to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "what the channel plays: while its source is STEM, the stems on its bus as a bit mask of pairs 1-8 (bit 0 = pair 1 = deck A stem 1); 0 = the analog input, sent whenever its source is ANALOG, whatever is on its bus; on channel N only bit N-1 (deck 1's stem N) or bit N+3 (deck 2's stem N)"},
  "channel.stem.push":        {"pattern": "/channel/{ch}/stem/push", "args": "i", "ch": [1, 4], "from": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj"], "to": ["core"], "meaning": "the channel's encoder pushed: on A, the channel's source becomes ANALOG -- REAPER opens its analog send and shuts its stems send, StemDeck is not asked and the stem on its bus stays there, unheard; on a stem (deck 1's or deck 2's stem N on channel N), the source becomes STEM and the stem the channel's only input -- the other deck's stem N goes to the return (AUX); on the stem already on its bus nothing moves; without StemDeck a stem push switches nothing, A still does"},
  "channel.stem.cursor":      {"pattern": "/channel/{ch}/stem/cursor", "args": "i", "ch": [1, 4], "from": ["core"], "to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "the channel's selector cursor: on channel N one of N-1 (deck 1's stem N), N+3 (deck 2's stem N) and 8 = A, the analog input; a stored cursor outside these comes back as 8"},
  "filter.frequency":         {"pattern": "/filter/frequency", "args": "f", "from": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj", "motion"], "to": ["core"], "relayed_to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "the master filter's cutoff (was /fx/frequency)"},
  "filter.resonance":         {"pattern": "/filter/resonance", "args": "f", "from": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj", "motion"], "to": ["core"], "relayed_to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "the master filter's resonance (was /fx/resonance)"},
  "filter.mode":              {"pattern": "/filter/mode", "args": "f|s", "from": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj", "motion"], "to": ["core"], "announced_to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "high-pass or low-pass (was /fx/mode)"},
  "filter.led":               {"pattern": "/filter/led", "args": "s", "from": ["core"], "to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "the filter section's lamp: blue HPF, green LPF (was /fx/led)"},
  "master.volume":            {"pattern": "/master/volume", "args": "f", "from": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj", "motion"], "to": ["core"], "relayed_to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "the main outputs"},
  "master.booth":             {"pattern": "/master/booth", "args": "f", "from": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj", "motion"], "to": ["core"], "relayed_to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "the booth outputs"},
  "master.phones-mix":        {"pattern": "/master/phones-mix", "args": "f", "from": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj", "motion"], "to": ["core"], "relayed_to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "cue <-> main in the headphones"},
  "master.phones-volume":     {"pattern": "/master/phones-volume", "args": "f", "from": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj", "motion"], "to": ["core"], "relayed_to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "the headphone level"},
  "master.aux-return":        {"pattern": "/master/aux-return", "args": "f", "from": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj", "motion"], "to": ["core"], "relayed_to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "the aux return, the fifth stereo input (was /master/return)"},
  "aux-return.stem.turn":     {"pattern": "/aux-return/stem/turn", "args": "i", "from": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj"], "to": ["core"], "meaning": "the aux return's encoder turned by this many clicks (signed): moves its cursor in a ring along the display, STEM (1) -> ANALOG (0) -> CUE (2) -> STEM; switches nothing"},
  "aux-return.stem.push":     {"pattern": "/aux-return/stem/push", "args": "i", "from": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj"], "to": ["core"], "meaning": "the aux return's encoder pushed: switches the return to the mode under the cursor; on CUE it toggles the return's cue and switches no mode"},
  "aux-return.stem":          {"pattern": "/aux-return/stem", "args": "iiiiiiiii", "from": ["core"], "to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "the aux return's cursor (0 = analog, 1 = stem, 2 = cue), then pairs 1-8: 1 = on StemDeck's AUX bus, i.e. on no channel (heard on the return in stem mode only)"},
  "aux-return.stem.mode":     {"pattern": "/aux-return/stem/mode", "args": "i", "from": ["core"], "to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "the aux return's mode, which chooses its source: 1 = stem (StemDeck's AUX bus plays on the return; analog 11/12 is shut), 0 = analog (analog inputs 11/12 play on the return; StemDeck's AUX is shut). Never both. In either mode every stem on no channel is on StemDeck's AUX"},
  "aux-return.cue.led":       {"pattern": "/aux-return/cue/led", "args": "f", "from": ["core"], "to": ["mixer", "desk", "motion"], "meaning": "the aux return's cue lamp, 1 = on"},
  "stemdeck.bus":             {"pattern": "/stemdeck/{deck}/{stem}/bus/{bus}", "args": "i", "deck": [1, 2], "stem": [1, 4], "bus": [1, 5], "from": ["core"], "to": ["stemdeck"], "meaning": "set one bus switch of a stem, 1 on 0 off; bus 1-4 the desk channels, 5 AUX (StemDeck's own cue bus 6 is gone since 2026-10-07: a channel is cued through its own bus); stem N reaches only bus N and 5 (AUX): StemDeck and Core refuse a switch onto another bus"},
  "stemdeck.buses":           {"pattern": "/stemdeck/{deck}/{stem}/buses", "args": "i", "deck": [1, 2], "stem": [1, 4], "from": ["stemdeck"], "to": ["core"], "meaning": "a stem's bus switches as a bit mask (bit 0 = bus 1), after every change and for all 8 stems after /stemdeck/recall"},
  "stemdeck.recall":          {"pattern": "/stemdeck/recall", "args": "i", "from": ["core"], "to": ["stemdeck"], "meaning": "report every stem's buses once; Core asks when StemDeck's hello is news"},
  "stemdeck.ahead":           {"pattern": "/stemdeck/ahead", "args": "ssif", "from": ["stemdeck"], "to": ["core"], "relayed_to": ["motion"], "meaning": "StemDeck's preview of the music on the audible deck (the MASTER deck when both are heard): the current bar's section (groove, build, drop, breakdown; none: no deck is heard, or it is not analysed yet), the next section (end: no change before the set ends), the bars until it (-1: a loop turns back before it) and the bar's energy 0-1 against the set's loud bars. On every downbeat and on a load, jump, loop, pitch or deck change; Core passes it on to the Motion it follows, unchanged, and never replays it"},
  "device.hello":             {"pattern": "/device/hello", "args": "ss", "from": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj", "stemdeck", "motion"], "to": ["core"], "meaning": "a device names itself and the sha256 of its copy of this file, at start and every 30 s; Core's window shows whether it is Core's own. Core follows the StemDeck and the Motion that arrived last (one of each), a remote Motion instead of the rig's own, and forgets one silent for a minute; and every desk (the A³ Mixer on a screen) that says hello with Core's own truth, four at most, each until it has been silent for a minute; a pro-DJ app says `prodj` and is followed as a desk of that kind"},
  "core.here":                {"pattern": "/core/here", "args": "sss", "from": ["core"], "to": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj", "motion", "stemdeck", "radla"], "meaning": "Core, every 2 s by broadcast: the URL of the joined truth, its fingerprint (sha256 of the canonical JSON) and a boot id, a random token that is new with every Core start (a changed boot id means a new Core, even one restarted within seconds); readers also accept the older two-string form"},
  "state.recall":             {"pattern": "/state/recall", "args": "i", "from": ["motion", "desk", "prodj"], "to": ["core"], "meaning": "say the state again; the answer is the ordinary messages"},
  "prodj.live":               {"pattern": "/prodj/live", "args": "i", "from": ["prodj", "desk", "motion"], "to": ["core"], "announced_to": ["desk", "prodj", "motion", "stemdeck"], "meaning": "the single global pro-DJ LIVE state, 1 = a pro-DJ app may operate. Core holds it, starts off, and repeats it every 5 s while on; a device counts it off 12 s after the last 1. Motion only ever sends 0"},
  "stemdeck.pointer":         {"pattern": "/stemdeck/pointer", "args": "iff", "from": ["prodj"], "to": ["core"], "relayed_to": ["stemdeck"], "meaning": "a click on StemDeck's screen picture: phase 0 down, 1 move, 2 up; x, y a share of the screen from top-left; forwarded only while pro-DJ LIVE"},
  "motion.pointer":           {"pattern": "/motion/pointer", "args": "iff", "from": ["prodj"], "to": ["core"], "relayed_to": ["motion"], "meaning": "a click on Motion's screen picture: phase 0 down, 1 move, 2 up; x, y a share of the screen from top-left; forwarded only while pro-DJ LIVE"},
  "core.device-at":           {"pattern": "/core/device/at", "args": "ss", "from": ["core"], "to": ["prodj"], "meaning": "where a followed device runs: device (motion, stemdeck) and host. Sent to a pro-DJ app when it joins or recalls, and when that device moves"},
  "beat":                     {"pattern": "/beat", "args": "iif", "from": ["beat-analyzer", "motion"], "to": ["core", "motion", "mixer", "desk", "radla", "beat-analyzer"], "meaning": "beat in bar, bar, tempo -- the clock (Motion sends it only in clock mode 0)"},
  "tap":                      {"pattern": "/tap", "args": "i", "from": ["mixer", "desk", "prodj", "motion"], "to": ["beat-analyzer"], "meaning": "a tap on the beat"},
  "clockmode":                {"pattern": "/clockmode", "args": "i", "from": ["motion"], "to": ["beat-analyzer"], "meaning": "0 a3motion, 1 intern, 2 pioneer"},
  "vu":                       {"pattern": "/vu/{n}", "args": "ff", "n": [1, 66], "from": ["beat-analyzer", "stemdeck"], "to": ["motion", "mixer", "desk", "radla"], "meaning": "peak, rms (linear) of VU channel n.
